# vertical-ui

> A spec, CSS and web components for user interfaces in vertical text on the web, starting with traditional Mongolian script (Mongol bichig).

## Spec

- [Spec index and rule levels](spec/README.md)
- [Terms](spec/terms.md): spine, column, line axis, block axis, run
- [Page model](spec/page-model.md): vertical-lr, horizontal canvas
- [Spine](spec/spine.md): aligning icons and controls to the text's stem
- [Orientation](spec/orientation.md): Latin, digits, CJK, emoji, punctuation
- [Columns](spec/columns.md): sizing, clipping, silent overflow
- [Logical directions](spec/logical-directions.md): what margins and alignment mean in vertical-lr
- [Shaping-safe styling](spec/shaping-safe-styling.md): highlights, links, fades
- [Fonts](spec/fonts.md): coverage, weight, vertical metrics
- [Scrolling](spec/scrolling.md): wheel and keys on a horizontal canvas
- [Small screens](spec/small-screens.md): dvh, safe areas, landscape

## Package

- [README](README.md): install and exports
- [Roadmap](ROADMAP.md)
